text:
maya: hey team, last-minute travel delay — flight pushed to 23:30 local. I need to swap primary for tonight's 22:00-06:00 PT shift. Pager still on me until handoff. :airplane: anyone able to take full primary or shadow + carry pager for the first couple hours?

sam: I can cover primary from 22:00-02:00 PT. I have a calendar conflict 00:15-01:00 (all-hands), so would need someone to be reachable for that 45m window as backup.

incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] New incident created: INC-2026-042 — embedding-serving latency spike. Severity: P2. Impact: increased token latency for embeddings API in us-west-2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-042

maya: ugh, timing. INC started ~21:30 PT, root cause unclear. @kai can you shadow while we swap? Kai has been on the latency chase earlier. Also leaving runbook pointer here: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embedding-latency#handoff (follow "night-handback" checklist).

kai: yep I can shadow until 01:30 PT and handle any paging during Sam's all-hands. I'll take ownership for the 00:15-01:00 slot.

maya: thanks. Quick handoff checklist I'm pasting — please ack when done:
1) note active alerts (INC-2026-042, pages ongoing)
2) current mitigation applied: reduced embed batch size to 8, enabled KV-cache warmup
3) temp fallback: route low-priority jobs to model-embed-small-v2 for next 2h
4) watch /metrics/embed_latency and /logs/embed-worker for >500ms spikes
5) contact PM + customer success if degradation persists >30m

sam: acked. I'll do a brief status note then drop pager to @anya at 22:05 PT if all quiet.

anya: I can take full primary if needed — I have open capacity after 23:00 PT. If Sam is good to start primary though I'll be standby for 00:15-01:00.

kai: logging quick commands I ran earlier in case useful:
```
# check recent 5m p50/p95 embedding latency
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?metric=embed_latency&range=5m" | jq .
# tail embed-worker logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed-worker -f --since=10m | rg "ERROR|WARN|latency"
```

sam: ran through the runbook, updated the "current-mitigations" section with the batch-size change and the fallback routing. Also left a note in the incident doc about spikes correlating with a large customer ingestion at 21:22.

maya: appreciated. Operational handover summary I'll leave in the thread: I'm switching out now — pager transfer at 22:00 PT. Sam primary 22:00-02:00 PT (will hand back if issues spike), Kai shadow and cover 00:15-01:00 PT during Sam's meeting, Anya standby after 23:00 PT.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Pager transfer recorded in oncall system. Previous primary: maya; New primary: sam; Shadow: kai; Timestamp: 1768612320.

anya: noted. I added a short playbook pointer in the runbook for the KV-cache warmup step (tiny tweak). :thumbsup:

sam: confirmed — I'm now on primary and have pager forwarded. If anyone sees >15% error rate increase, ping immediately and I'll escalate.

maya: thanks all, really appreciate the cover. Leaving a final note: if latency doesn't settle within 30m, escalate to infra and consider circuit-breaker for high-cost embed jobs. I'll be reachable via DMs if anything critical comes up. :wave:

kai: all good — monitoring dashboards and will alert on any regression. GLHF.

sam: closing thread for handoff; will post another update if we need extended coverage.
